entities.name: Trennet
entities.description: An ambitious vedalken wizard on Mirrodin who sought the rank of certarch and control of a spire.

entities.name: Sarja
entities.description: A Neurok woman who competed with Trennet for Research Spire Eleven and won it.

entities.name: Politus
entities.description: The vedalken leader who sought volunteers to reclaim Research Spire Eleven.

entities.name: Research Spire Eleven
entities.description: A vedalken spire taken by the Phyrexians, which Trennet and Sarja competed to reclaim.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders who destroyed spires and killed many vedalken on Mirrodin.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The artificial plane where Trennet lived.

entities.name: Phyrexian invasion
entities.description: The invasion of Mirrodin by the Phyrexians.

events.summary: Politus asks for volunteers to retake Research Spire Eleven; Trennet volunteers at once, with Sarja as his only competition.
events.quote: Trennet immediately volunteered, driven by the promise of control over the spire.

events.summary: Trennet hides in his clone shell, planning to control Sarja's creature once it defeats the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Trennet hid within his clone shell, planning to control Sarja's creature after it emerged to defeat the Phyrexians.

events.summary: Trennet's shell is damaged and he is forced out to fight; Sarja's clone shell proves to be another clone shell.
events.quote: Trennet's clone shell was damaged by the Phyrexians, forcing him out of his protective shell.

events.summary: Trennet controls a Phyrexian drake-lord, which breaks free and nearly kills him; Sarja kills it and he concedes the spire to her.
events.quote: Sarja then revealed herself, killing the drake and forcing Trennet to concede the spire to her.

events.summary: Healed but humiliated, Trennet watches Sarja take control of the spire and plans to reclaim another one.
events.quote: Although Trennet's physical injuries were healed, his pride was deeply wounded.

relations.note: rivals for control of Research Spire Eleven
relations.quote: Their initial meeting was contentious, with Sarja mocking him and deepening his animosity towards her.
